lines.en: : Okay, Uta. Any final questions before you introduce yourself to the rest of class?
: Yes. What time is lunch? I’m starving.
: School literally just started. Didn’t you eat breakfast?
: I was so excited to meet everyone that I forgot breakfast was even a thing.
: I’m going to need you to tone it down a bit. You’re too happy for this time of day.
: No can do, Sensei. Oh, another question-
: I still haven’t moved into my dorm yet. Do you have any idea when that’s going to happen?
: I’m trying to avoid sleeping in an alleyway tonight if at all possible.
: During the summer it would be fine.
: I used to go camping all the time when I lived in the country, but a girl my size would probably die if I slept out in the snow.
: Talk to Makoto about that.
: Which one is Makoto?
: The one that looks like a student council president. You’ll know when you see her.
: Got it.
: Anything else, then?
: Yeah. Are you and Maya really not boyfriend and girlfriend? Cause I’ve got an eye for that sort of thing and I can just feel the love.
: I’m sure you’ll feel the same thing about my relationship with pretty much everyone in no time.
: Ah! So there is some back-scratching going on here!
: I’ve gotta go call my parents and let them know the time has finally come for their little girl to become a woman!
: Can we get your intro out of the way first before you go and jeopardize my livelihood?
: Oh, right. That’s what we were doing.
: Sorry, just having so much fun hanging out here in the hallway with you that I forgot I was even in[school] for a second.
: So, if that’s everything-
: Oh! One more thing!
: Another? How many questions can you possibly have?
: Do I look good in glasses?
: People always used to make fun of me because they made my eyes look huge or something and I don’t want everyone to think I’m some kinda bug-eyed Kansai freak.
: You look as adorable as ever.
: As ever? Did little old Uta-chan leave such a good impression on you that she’s been forever stapled into your brain as the ideal girl?
: Or, better yet, the ideal woman?
: But Sensei, it’s so soon. We barely even know each other. I’m not ready for such a big leap yet.
: You were about to call your parents and tell them you were going to become a woman just a minute ago.
: You were gonna make me a woman in front of the whole class?! Sensei! That’s so lewd!
: Don’t get me wrong, I’m all about dating someone older and stronger and cooler than me, but in front of everyone else? That’s just too much!
: Keep your voice down, please...
: OH GOD HE’S ALREADY SICK OF ME! I CAME ON TOO STRONG AGAIN!
: UTA USHIBORI’S DAYS AS A NORMAL HIGH SCHOOL MAID ARE OVER!
: I SHOULD HAVE STAYED IN NARA AND MARRIED A DEER!
: Really?
: Day-one of transfers and you've already lost control?
Wakana pulls open her door and peeks her head out just far enough to slight me for being unable to control Uta.
: Just be happy I got this one instead of you.
: UTA USHIBORI ISN’T EVEN A GIRL ANYMORE! SHE’S JUST “THIS ONE!”
: Uta, please...Let’s just go inside and introduce you to everyone else.
: I HOPE THE STUDENTS ARE DEER!
: Please calm your miscreant down, Sensei...I’m trying to actually do my job over here.
: I’ve got it, Wakana...
: Uta, they’re normal [high_school] girls just like you.
: Normal?...
: So...not deer?...
: Not deer.
: Hah...
: I want to fucking die.
Wakana disappears back into her classroom and probably dumps a bunch of dead animals into a cauldron or something.
She looks like the type who would do that.
I wind up calming Uta down after another minute or two and she finally agrees to go meet everyone else.
She regains her composure rather quickly and skips into the classroom, stopping right at my desk and turning to face the class without even writing her name on the board.
: Hm? Isn’t that the girl from the maid cafe?
: What’s she doing here?
: She must be...part of all the transfer students coming to our[school] instead now.
: Holy heck, I think she’s even shorter than me!
: I’m not actually...tall...am I?
: Yeaaaaah I don’t think so, Miku. Sorry.
: Why do all of the girls our age have such nice legs?
: I’ve been wondering that ever since I was little, Tsuneyo. I feel ya.
: Do you also get the urge to touch them or am I just broken?
: If wanting to touch girls means you’re broken, I never want to be fixed.
: Really? Another one? Our class is already fucking packed.
: Yumi, only like, half of the desks are occupied.
: And why do you care in the first place? You never even come here.
: Still my fuckin’ classroom. Been wanting to come even less since Ireland and Noodles showed up.
: Sure you’re not just jealous that it’s going to get even harder for you to grab Sensei’s attention?
: The fuck are you talkin’ about? I’m like the only one not trying to do that shit.
: Shouldn’t you be the one freaking out if that’s the case?
: I have no idea what you’re talking about~
: And even if I did, there’s no way Sensei would be into someone that tiny.
: He clearly likes more mature girls. Ones that can stand on their own two feet, if you know what I mean.
: More like ones that can lay on their back and take-
: Excuse me?
: I didn’t say anythin’.
: Hi everybody! My name’s Uta Ushibori and I just transferred in from Kumon-mi Academy after it sunk into the ground!
Oh, so we’re [kumon_mi_high] and the other[school] was Kumon-mi Academy. That’s not confusing at all.
: I came here from Nara a couple years ago to take care of my grandpa.
: Wait, really? I didn’t know that...
: Oh! Ami’s here! Hi, Ami!
: Hahaha...hey...
: Anyway, my grandpa died last year and I obviously don’t have to take care of him anymore as a result.
: But I obviously can’t go home either because they closed off Kumon-mi, so now I just spend my time working at a maid cafe and shopping!
: Umm...what else...what else?
: Oh yeah! Being born in the country has kinda made it so I can like...share too much or be too...umm, what’s the word...intrusive at times?
: For example, if I ever find out anyone likes anyone else, I’ll probs spill the beans accidentally. Please don’t hate me when that happens.
: Um...Is that good enough for an intro? I’m running outta steam here.
: I’ve suddenly forgotten everything interesting about myself.
: Can you do the thing?
: The thing?...
: You mean the Uta-chan thing? The thing that makes boys’ and girls’ hearts melt out of their chest?
: Are you really sure it’s okay?
: I don’t know if it will have the same impact without my uniform on.
: The thing? She doesn’t mean that thing, does she?...
: What other thing could she possibly mean?
: Also, why’s she all chummy with Sensei?
: I know he’s spent millions of Yen on her but she’s not even in maid-mode right now.
: I’m much cuter than her outside of the cafe. Right, Maya?
: Right, Ami. You’re the cutest ever. No one can compete.
: Thank you, Maya. I love you.
: Uh-huh...
: Well, uhh...I guess since the teacher asked me to do this, I can’t possibly say no.
: Ahem...
I have to admit, I didn’t think she’d actually go for it in front of the entire class.
But the way I look at it, what Uta is about to do will either make or break her[school] life.
Let’s hope her power is strong enough to capture all of the girls' hearts the way it captured mine.
: FLAVOR...BEEEEEAAAAAAAAAAM!!!!!!!!!!
: So much...power...
: I can feel the flavor from all the way over here!
: I don’t feel any different.
: I feel...light-headed...
: I am now delicious.
: Oh...my...fucking...god...
: Yumi, you should do that for Chinami’s scrambled eggs one day. She’d love it.
: I’d rather fucking die.
: What’s this? A non-believer in our midst?
: Let me guess, you’re the class delinquent? The real tough one that nobody messes with?
: Guess so. What’s it to you, flavor-bitch?
: Come on, Yumi. That was just upsetting.
: Fuck off, Chika.
: Hmm...I see, I see. You do appear to be rather intimidating. But Uta Ushibori does not shy away from bullies!
: So what? You trying to fight or some shit? That what’s going on?
: Yes! No! Sort of!
: I challenge you to an arm wrestling match! The loser needs to stop bullying everyone for the rest of eternity!
: No more bad names! No more making fun of beams designed to warm hearts!
: Uh-huh. And when I win, what do I get?
: I will never cast my spell in class again...
Oh no. Anything but that.
: Fine. I’m in. Let’s do this shit.
: Not gonna lie, I’m kinda rooting for Uta here.
: For once in my life, I am proud to say that I am not the center of attention.
: This is a huge victory for Molly MacCormack.
: I wonder who’s going to win? I’d normally say Yumi but...Uta might have some kind of hidden country-girl strength or something?
: Yes, yes. I, too, possess the hidden power of my ancestors.
: You sure you want to do this? I ain’t holdin’ anything back, FYI.
: Of course. Like I said, Uta Ushibori doesn’t let bullies be bullies!
: Your days of crime are over...umm...ummm...
: Yumi...
: Your days of crime are over, Yumi!
: Someone! Count us down!
: Oh! Uhh...
: Three...
: Two...
: One...
: GO!
: AHHHHH!!! LET GO! LET GO! LET GO!
: Alas...evil has triumphed once again...
: So, you’re done with all that flavor beam shit now, right?
: I WILL NOT...BE BULLIED!
: Hey! We had a fuckin’ deal!
: I won! So try that beam shit again and I’ll fuck up your other arm, too!
: Jesus, Yumi, let go! You’re going to break the poor girl’s wrist!
: FINE! NO MORE FLAVOR BEAM IN CLASS!
: BUT...LET IT BE KNOWN! I WAS ONLY DOING...AS I WAS TOLD!
: YOU HAVE NOT...SEEN THE LAST...OF UTA-CHAN!
The[school] day ended with me taking Uta to the nurse.
Thankfully, there was no break or fracture or anything like that. She just pulled a muscle from how suddenly Yumi pinned her arm down.
I have to say, it was kind of depressing seeing her lose after how much she hyped herself up.
For a moment, it seemed like she had the potential to be the class hero.
Unfortunately, the days of the flavor beam are now gone.
At least in[school], that is.
I have every intention of abusing that hidden power of hers each and every time I go to the maid cafe.
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
